hypotheses.Q0_quadrature_direction_converges: Median cosine to the finite endpoint product delta is nondecreasing within tolerance 0.005 from one through four nodes in every cell.
hypotheses.Q1_three_nodes_predict_the_finite_vector: Three-node quadrature has median endpoint cosine at least 0.98 and median norm-ratio error at most 0.10 in every cell.
hypotheses.Q2_three_node_continuous_patch_preserves: The continuous three-node predicted vector recovers at least 0.80 effect-weighted KL and 0.70 median per-example KL in every cell.
hypotheses.Q3_three_node_support_preserves_behavior: Three-node suffix-selected rank-256 support populated with exact endpoint values recovers at least 0.80 effect-weighted KL in every cell.
hypotheses.Q4_quadrature_repairs_midpoint_overshoot: Three-node continuous recovery exceeds one-node midpoint recovery by at least 0.50 in every cell.
hypotheses.Q5_four_nodes_have_diminishing_returns: Four-node continuous recovery differs from three-node recovery by at most 0.03 in every cell.
hypotheses.Q6_quadrature_compiler_transfers_ood: Three-node recovery differs by at most 0.10 between FineWeb and TinyStories at each layer.
hypotheses.Q7_quadrature_is_prospective: Every quadrature node lies strictly inside the edit path and endpoint product values are inspected only after all predicted vectors are frozen.
